name: Practical Guide
description: Multi-chapter paginated guide document with cover, numbered cards, callouts, and ending page.
prompt: Create a multi-chapter Practical Guide document for the provided topic. Use a dedicated cover page (.cover) with title and subtitle, chapter sections (.chapter-header), numbered cards (.numbered-card), key insight boxes (.tip-box), code/monospace blocks (.code-block), comparison tables (.compare-row), and an ending page (.ending).
